description: Mirrors capabilities/view.json for the `pilot`-feature build (see build.rs) - keep both files identical apart from this line. Per-window capability of a remote-view window (design doc §13). Deliberately NOT `core:default`: a window that renders a remote screen and forwards input needs exactly four application commands, its own close (`allow-close` for the close-requested event, `allow-destroy` for the unconditional close the JS API issues once that event is not prevented), and the close-request event that turns closing the window into ending the session. Everything else — filesystem, shell, network, clipboard, other windows' commands — is absent rather than denied, and there are no wildcard entries.
